checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Hands return to knees, reach overhead and circle outward; wrists follow forearms.
checks.feet: Both legs move symmetrically from tabletop to diagonal extension; head and chest remain curled.
checks.movement: Supine curled chest; tabletop knees extend diagonally while arms reach overhead, then circle arms outward and return hands to knees.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Eight-second controlled extension and arm-circle return.
